# CGScholar

> CGScholar is an academic publishing and conference platform hosting international research proceedings, journals, and books across humanities, social sciences, architecture, and interdisciplinary studies.

CGScholar operates as a scholarly publishing hub managed by Common Ground Research Networks, hosting major international conferences and peer-reviewed publications. The platform specializes in conference proceedings from global academic events, academic journals, and books across diverse disciplines including humanities, sustainability, learning, social sciences, and the built environment.

## Key Topics

- Conference Proceedings
- International Conferences
- Academic Publishing
- Humanities Research
- Constructed Environment
- Architecture
- Social Sciences
- Academic Journals
- Sustainability
- Learning & Education
- Interdisciplinary Research
- Peer-Reviewed Publications
- Book Imprints
- Cultural Studies
- Urban Studies

## International Conference Proceedings

- [Twenty-Third International Conference on New Directions in the Humanities - Conference Proceedings](https://cgscholar.com/publishers/conference-proceedings/twenty-third-international-conference-on-new-directions-in-the-humanities): Proceedings from 23rd International Conference on New Directions in Humanities, Hawaii 2025
- [Thirty-First International Conference on Learning Conference Proceedings](https://cgscholar.com/publishers/conference-proceedings/thirtyfirst-international-conference-on-learning): Proceedings from 31st International Conference on Learning, Utrecht University 2024
- [Nineteenth International Conference on Interdisciplinary Social Sciences Conference Proceedings](https://cgscholar.com/publishers/conference-proceedings/nineteenth-international-conference-on-interdisciplinary-social-sciences-conference-proceedings): Proceedings from 19th International Conference on Social Sciences, Jagiellonian 2024
- [Thirteenth International Conference on The Constructed Environment Conference Proceedings](https://cgscholar.com/publishers/conference-proceedings/thirteenth-international-conference-on-the-constructed-environment-conference-proceedings): Proceedings from 13th International Conference on Constructed Environment, Hawaii 2023
- [Fifteenth International Conference on The Constructed Environment Conference Proceedings](https://cgscholar.com/publishers/conference-proceedings/fifteenth-international-conference-on-the-constructed-environment-conference-proceedings-88bd22d3-8c71-406c-9112-aee28ff0a6fc): Proceedings from 15th International Conference on Constructed Environment, Berlin 2025

## Academic Journals

- [Revista Internacional de Humanidades](https://cgscholar.com/publishers/journals/revista-internacional-de-humanidades): International Spanish-language humanities journal published by CGScholar
- [The International Journal of Communication and Linguistic Studies](https://cgscholar.com/publishers/journals/the-international-journal-of-communication-and-linguistic-studies): Peer-reviewed international journal on communication, linguistics, and media studies

## Books & Book Series

- [Diversity in Organizations, Communities & Nations Book Imprint](https://cgscholar.com/publishers/book-series/diversity-in-organizations-communities-nations-book-imprint): Book imprint series on diversity studies across social contexts and organizations
- [The Urban Legacy of Olympic Villages: From Paris to Beijing (1924–2022)](https://cgscholar.com/publishers/books/the-urban-legacy-of-olympic-villages): Book on Olympic villages' urban legacy and mega-event impacts 1924-2022
- [The Beautiful Game Reimagined: Women's Soccer in Brazil](https://cgscholar.com/publishers/books/the-beautiful-game-reimagined): Book on women's soccer in Brazil published by CGScholar Sports & Society Imprint
- [Slicing Spaces: Performance of Architecture in Cinema](https://cgscholar.com/publishers/books/slicing-spaces): Book analyzing architecture's performance in cinema and film space
- [New Studies in Indian and Comparative Philosophy](https://cgscholar.com/publishers/books/new-studies-in-indian-and-comparative-philosophy): Scholarly book on Indian and comparative philosophy research and interpretation
- [Not Losing Face: Actuality and Potentiality of Power](https://cgscholar.com/publishers/books/not-losing-face): Academic book exploring power, social fabric, and cultural analysis

## Conference Events & Platforms

- [22nd International Conference on Environmental, Cultural, Economic & Social Sustainability](https://cgscholar.com/events/22nd-international-conference-on-environmental-cultural-economic-social-sustainability): Event microsite for 22nd International Conference on Sustainability in Rodos
- [XXXIII Congreso Internacional sobre Aprendizaje](https://cgscholar.com/events/xxxiii-congreso-internacional-sobre-aprendizaje): 33rd International Congress on Learning event platform in Hong Kong

## Research Articles

- [Blackpool Reverie](https://cgscholar.com/publishers/articles/blackpool-reverie): Article on urban regeneration and gentrification in Blackpool using practice-led research
- [Dialogism and Rhetorical Listening in an Age of Polarization](https://cgscholar.com/publishers/articles/dialogism-and-rhetorical-listening-in-an-age-of-polarization): Article on dialogism and rhetorical listening addressing political polarization
